Answer the question using the supplied passages.
Identify the source of your answer.
If the passages don't establish an answer, say so.

Question:
Who approved CN-TFE's oil pressure switch replacement for return to service?

Source: WO-2025-0095, section 
Work order WO-2025-0095: CN-TFD, oil pressure switch replacement
Parts used

Certification: the work above was performed in accordance with 14 CFR Part 43 and the procedures manual. The aircraft is airworthy for the work performed.

Performed by: N. Berrada

Return to service: A. Tazi, licence MA-B1-0457

Source: WO-2025-0095, section 
Work order WO-2025-0095: CN-TFD, oil pressure switch replacement
Work performed

Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11.

Removed switch P/N 83278 at 2,951.3 hours since installation.

Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-037.

Source: WO-SCAN, section 
Work orders WO-2021-0544, WO-2024-0071, WO-2026-0388 (scanned)
Work order WO-2021-0544: CN-TFE, oil pressure switch replacement (scanned)
Work performed

Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11 paragraph (g)(6) and Cessna Service Bulletin SB 07-79-01.

Removed switch P/N 83278 at 3,000.4 hours since installation. Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks.

Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-014.

Performed by: Y. Alaoui

Approved for return to service: A. Tazi

Source: WO-SCAN, section 
Work orders WO-2021-0544, WO-2024-0071, WO-2026-0388 (scanned)
Work order WO-2021-0544: CN-TFE, oil pressure switch replacement (scanned)
ANFA AERO SERVICES

| Date | 30 August 2021 |
| Registration | CN-TFE |
| Aircraft | Cessna 172R |
| Serial number | 17280744 |
| Airframe total time at completion (h) | 10,650.2 |

Source: WO-SCAN, section 
Work orders WO-2021-0544, WO-2024-0071, WO-2026-0388 (scanned)
Work order WO-2024-0071: CN-TFA, oil pressure switch replacement (scanned)
Work performed

Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11 paragraph (g)(6).

Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. AD compliance record updated. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-022.

Performed by: S. Idrissi

Approved for return to service: A. Tazi

The same source confirms the aircraft registration as CN-TFE (Cessna 172R, serial 17280744) with a completion date of 30 August 2021.
